players.product: substrate / package maker buying Hanmi PCB saw-vision (MSVP) equipment

quarterly_data.signal: LG Innotek says Package Solution division head Cho Ji-tae (Executive Vice President, appointed late last year to lead the semiconductor substrate business) is pursuing a large-scale investment to expand semiconductor substrate production capacity to more than 2 times, as demand for high-value semiconductor substrates surges in the AI era; the release ties this to the recently stated goal of growing Package Solution into a KRW 1 trillion operating-profit business within 5 years, and says the company is also driving expansion of its new FC-BGA substrate business.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor substrate capacity to more than 2 times
